decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-96 MODIFY already fully records the conditional relocation of the two second-page photos through overflow_photo_handling, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The conditional relocation changes photo placement, not the established full-document layout coverage, pass count, design approach, or spacing policy.
Relocating the two photos does not change font consistency rules or resolve the outstanding bold-formatting ambiguity.
The photo-relocation instruction does not change the background treatment required for the identified special pages.
Moving photos from the letter to another section does not alter the Blue Mesa brand identity or required brand elements.
The source decision concerns photo placement and does not change any table source, replacement, or integration rule.
Allowing the two photos to move to another section does not authorize reordering the fixed RFQ sections.
The instruction preserves the photos by relocating them and does not change the required content basis or resolve whether Section 11 belongs in the proposal.
The photo-relocation rule does not change Canva editing access, ownership, asset policy, or delivery of the editable design link.
Relocating photos has no necessary effect on the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
The source decision addresses only the two letter photos and does not change organization-chart inclusion or placement.
The one-page letter condition is already owned by the cover-letter requirement; the source photo-relocation update does not change the overall 34-page limit or document spacing policy.
